title: Intent to File, Substantive Claims and Withdrawals — Disability Compensation
content:
**Recording an intent to file.** For Disability Compensation, an intent to file may be recorded by telephone, online, by mail or in person, and it stays in effect for the intent-to-file validity period in calendar days.

**Which claim keeps the intent-to-file date.** A claim takes the intent-to-file date as its date of claim only if it is received not later than the intent-to-file validity period in calendar days after the date VA received the intent to file. Count calendar days starting the day after the intent to file was received; a claim received on the last day still qualifies. Only the first completed claim received in that period uses the intent to file, and a later claim takes its own received date. The anchor is the received date recorded on the intent to file the claim cites; the comparison is with the received date recorded on the completed claim.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, with the 365-day validity period).** Intent to file received 20 August 2025; day 1 is 21 August 2025 and the last day is 20 August 2026.

| Completed claim received | Date of claim |
|---|---|
| 20 August 2026 (first completed claim in the period) | 20 August 2025, the intent-to-file date |
| 21 August 2026 | 21 August 2026, its own received date |
| A second completed claim on 1 March 2026, after a first one already used the intent | 1 March 2026, its own received date |

**Substantive claims.** A substantive claim for an increase, a new or secondary condition, individual unemployability or a temporary total rating must be submitted online, by mail or in person on the prescribed form and is never taken by telephone.

**Withdrawal.** A claim can be withdrawn only while no rating decision citing that claim exists. Whether such a decision exists is read from the award's rating-decision records for that claim. A withdrawn claim does not keep its date of claim, and refiling starts a new date of claim unless an unused intent to file still protects it.

| Rating decision citing the claim on record | Withdrawal possible |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| One or more | No |
